cases.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (ZNF91 heterochromatin)
cases.mechanism_detail: In XDP patient-derived neural progenitor cells, ZNF91 deposits H3K9me3/DNA methylation over the intronic SVA, forming a mini-heterochromatin domain; removing it aggravates the XDP phenotype with increased TAF1 intron retention and reduced TAF1 expression, i.e. the SVA causes intron retention/reduced expression that heterochromatin partly constrains.
cases.quote: This is critical for XDP pathology; removal of local heterochromatin severely aggravates the XDP molecular phenotype, resulting in increased TAF1 intron retention and reduced expression.
